name: branding-black-geist-style-guide-with-lime-and-lavender-cards
title: Geist Style Guide with Lime and Lavender
whatItIs: A black style guide page with a 'Style Guide' title and weights list, a giant white 'Geist' specimen crossed by a pill with tool icons, and interlocking rounded colour cards for Electric Lime, Lavender Pink, Pearl White, Black and White with hex codes.
whatItMeans: Interlocking cards make the palette feel like puzzle pieces, and neon lime with lavender feels fresh and playful on black.
techniques: Giant specimen overlapped by a pill of icons
Colour cards notched into each other
Arrow icons in each card corner
Names and hex codes at the card edges
Neon lime as the lead colour

vocabulary.definition: Rounded cards notched into one another like puzzle pieces.
A capsule holding a few tool icons.
A page documenting type, colour and usage.
